name: Adwave
summary: Advertising platform that plans and runs ads on phones, TV, search and social from your website, paid from a prepaid wallet.
best_for: small businesses that want ads on phones, TV, search and social planned from their website, paid from a prepaid wallet that cannot go into debt
skip_if: you want to compare ad formats and results before creating an account, you need a monthly invoice rather than prepaid funding, or you are an agency that needs the licence price upfront
honest_knock: Most of the product sits behind an account, so we could not see the ad formats, targeting options or reporting before signing up. The agency licence price is not published, and a card top-up costs more than the amount that reaches your wallet.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-09 on waverunner.adwave.com/pricing, the wallet and billing help page) Adwave has no subscription for businesses: you fund a prepaid wallet and live campaigns charge their daily budget from it. A top-up can be any amount from $30 to $50,000, with presets of $100, $250 and $1,000. Card top-ups add the card processing fee on top, so the wallet receives the full amount you chose; bank (ACH) top-ups carry no added fee. Auto-refill is optional, with a default and minimum refill of $100. The page says the daily budget is the whole media bill, there are no hidden fees, and tracking, reporting and API access are free. Your first campaign comes with free starter ads; later ad generation and Ad Library extras use published unit prices that you see before you accept. Agencies pay a licence, and the page does not state its price.

compare_with.why: AdCreative.ai is in our directory and focuses on generating ad creatives, while Adwave also places the media. Compare what each charges for the first campaign and who owns the ad accounts afterwards
